verbatim: and why the fuck are your probes behaviors still affecting my dialin desk
measured: they did: every named probe ran through window.popitProbe inside the one QWebEngineView the owner was working in, so choose repainted his desk, goHome and openApp changed its surface, and the audit route navigated it to settings, prose and springboard; the reading and the acted-on page were the same page because there was only one

verbatim: measurement must not touch the window the owner is using
measured: first attempt was a second hidden QWebEngineView in the same process; it killed the desk every twenty seconds (watchdog.log: toast API absent, started toast pid=..., recovered, six times in a minute) and was reverted, because a crash loop is worse than the fault it was meant to fix

verbatim: an acting probe is refused against the desk by name, and the desk reports its own paint
measured: ACTING_PROBES (choose, fallback, goHome, openApp, windowClose) are refused with probe-act-needs-measurement-window and a route act with route-needs-measurement-window before anything is queued; POST eval choose answers 409 with that code; the desk pushes its own paint to /api/toast/window/report, and after a refused probe the report is byte-identical (desk paint unchanged: True)

verbatim: the bar carries the pinned baseline's buttons
measured: at the desk's current 480 px width the four controls wrapped to a second row because the pinned baseline makes them taller than the old hand-sized ones; the bar is now one row (flex-wrap: nowrap, tighter gap, a title that gives way), the controls keep the baseline's padding and height, and the witness capture shows mark, name, LIVE, HOME, SETTINGS, PIN, CLOSE on one line
